exposure: full-term deliveries resulting in neonates diagnosed with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy
mismanaged delivery resulting in hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy
cases of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy that were not associated with mismanagement
cohort: All deliveries at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Hadassah University Hospital, Mt. Scopus campus, Jerusalem, Israel, during 2009-2014
finding: There was a significant, transient increase in the rate of unscheduled cesarean deliveries in the 4 weeks following a delivery resulting in HIE attributed to obstetric mismanagement.
mod_finding: This study found that the rate of unscheduled cesarean deliveries increased in the 4 weeks following mismanaged deliveries resulting in hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy.
